allow: Bash(# Kill the legacy screensaver to force a refresh killall legacyScreenSaver-x86_64 killall legacyScreenSaver echo ""Killed legacy screensaver processes"" sleep 2 # Now open Lock Screen settings to trigger the preview open ""x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.Lock-Screen-Settings.extension"" echo ""Waiting for preview to load..."" sleep 8 ps aux)
Bash(# Check if rustup can be installed via Homebrew brew list rust && echo ""Rust installed via Homebrew"" brew info rustup-init)
Bash(# Check for any dyld/loader errors log show --predicate ''message CONTAINS ""dyld"" AND message CONTAINS ""Spacesaver""'' --last 5m)
Bash(# Check if macOS can see the screensaver at all defaults read com.apple.screensaver)
Bash(# Check bundle loading by examining the executable with nm nm -gU ""/Users/scott/Library/Screen Savers/Spacesaver.saver/Contents/MacOS/Spacesaver"")
Bash(# Check for OBJC metadata nm ""/Users/scott/Library/Screen Savers/Spacesaver.saver/Contents/MacOS/Spacesaver"")
Bash(# Check for Rust log file ls -la ~/Library/Caches/com.spacesaver.Spacesaver/ || echo ""Cache dir not found"" # Also try to find any recent log messages log show --last 1m)
